name: Microsoft 365 Audit
description: Collects Entra ID sign-in and directory audit logs, Purview unified audit activity, Defender alerts and incidents, Identity Protection risk data and Secure Score from any number of Microsoft 365 tenants into Elasticsearch.
requirements: Microsoft Graph application permission AuditLog.Read.All (sign-ins, directory audits, provisioning)
Microsoft Graph application permission Directory.Read.All (tenant name, sign-in enrichment)
Microsoft Graph application permission AuditLogsQuery.Read.All or the per-workload AuditLogsQuery-*.Read.All permissions (Purview unified audit log)
Microsoft Graph application permission SecurityAlert.Read.All (Defender alerts)
Microsoft Graph application permission SecurityIncident.Read.All (Defender incidents)
Microsoft Graph application permissions IdentityRiskEvent.Read.All, IdentityRiskyUser.Read.All, IdentityRiskyServicePrincipal.Read.All (Identity Protection)
Microsoft Graph application permission SecurityEvents.Read.All (Secure Score)
Entra ID P1/P2 licensing for sign-in logs; Microsoft Purview Audit (Standard) for unified audit log
